review.caption_visibility: Burned-in captions are readable at both reviewed resolutions; sampled beats align with scenes.
review.ui_readability: Primary headings, controls, and form contents readable at both resolutions; dense explanatory copy is smaller at 960x540.

claims.no_model: Opening screen says no model is connected.
claims.no_live_people_or_moderation: Community view explicitly says no live people or moderation are connected.
claims.consent_and_no_send: Exact audience preview and unchecked consent are shown; no-send disclosure is repeated, with the post control shown in a muted disabled-looking style.
claims.no_verified_provider_or_booking: Support screen says no provider is verified and no appointment can be requested.

limitations: Audio could not be auditioned; subjective intelligibility, mix quality, and word-for-word speech/caption agreement are not certified.
No physical-device playback or execution test of the underlying UI was performed.
Captions are burned into the video; there is no selectable or toggleable subtitle stream.
H.264 High 4:4:4 Predictive may have narrower hardware/browser support than common H.264 High, despite successful FFmpeg decoding.
